Class 8A playoff preview: Stevenson and Warren in Opening Round
Stevenson and Warren play in Class 8A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, one game will be competitive and one will be a blowout.
Stevenson and Warren play in Class 8A Opening Round games this weekend, and according to our projections, one game will be competitive and one will be a blowout.
The top 16 seeds in the 48-team Class 8A field have byes in the Opening Round, and the other 32 teams play Friday and Saturday, Oct. 23-24.
Winners advance to the First Round on Saturday, Oct. 31.
We call a game competitive if our projection has it decided by 10 points or fewer and a blowout if the margin is 21 points or more.
Opening Round schedule and predictions
Friday, Oct. 23
- 7 p.m.: No. 36 Warren (4-5) at No. 29 Naperville Central (5-4) (Naperville Central 29, Warren 19)
- 7:15 p.m.: No. 37 Stevenson (4-5) at No. 28 Lockport (5-4) (Lockport 35, Stevenson 13)
Game Capsules
No. 37 Stevenson (4-5) at No. 28 Lockport (5-4)
Stevenson travels to Lockport in the Class 8A Opening Round, and the winner plays at No. 5 Bolingbrook (8-1) in the First Round.
Kickoff is 7:15 p.m. Friday.
#37 Stevenson (4-5)
Stevenson (4-5) is the No. 37 seed in the 48-team Class 8A field and visits No. 28 Lockport in the Opening Round. It qualified with a losing record.
Stevenson went 4-5 overall and 4-3 in North Suburban, scoring 197 points and allowing 209, an average margin of -1.3 a game.
Stevenson went 6-4 last season, including 0-1 in playoffs. Stevenson has reached the playoffs in seven of the last 10 seasons.
